title: In a place-content-roles/3 map Slot fit takes keep or replace from the role, and R5 and the verify viewer accept stat.proof_image faces
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/test/slot-fit.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/test/content-label-rules.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/test/content-map-verify-viewer.test.mjs
S2: Read the lines of the four tests named in run.tests.
expect: Each reports ok: a version 3 map's avatar, cut-out, signature and face strip with person, business, quote and stat roles get replace photo and no customize keep, and the result has no keepDerivationProblems (pre-fix: replace keep, customize keep); a version 2 map with the same roles still keeps them by kind; R5 and viewer rule 1 accept stat.proof_image on avatar and avatar-group and still fail it on a signature.
evidence: JA Boxing 1.0.8 phase A (#46): with the develop code the --fit derivation left R5 at 14 failing slots and the slot-roles gate at 28 failing lines; with the fix R5 is 1 (a labelling issue) and the gate passes.

tests: in a version 3 map the role, not the measured kind, sets customize and fit.replace
a version 2 map with the same roles still keeps faces, signatures and cut-outs by their kind
R5: faces that prove a number pass with stat.proof_image (ADR 0040); a signature or cut-out under it fails
rule 1 accepts faces that prove a number (stat.proof_image, ADR 0040) and still marks a signature under it
